results.title: Cotton co-sponsoring federal legislation to address potential Medicaid fraud
results.description: U.S. Sen. Tom Cotton is supporting federal legislation to enable state Medicaid Fraud control units to combat beneficiary fraud, in addition to provider fraud, he announced Friday.
